signature.name: Fremantle Prison
signature.detail: A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of Australia's most intact convict-era prisons, with guided tours through cell blocks and tunnels. Book a tour in advance, as the popular tunnel and night tours sell out; it is a short train ride from central Perth to Fremantle.

signature.name: Elizabeth Quay
signature.detail: The waterfront hub on the Swan River, with the Swan Bell Tower nearby and easy access to ferries and riverside walks. Visit in the late afternoon for sunset over the river; it is walkable from the CBD or reachable by train to Elizabeth Quay station.

signature.name: Cottesloe Beach
signature.detail: Perth's classic white-sand beach, great for swimming and sunset views over the Indian Ocean. Go early morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat and crowds; the train to Cottesloe station puts you a short walk from the sand.

signature.name: Kings Park and Botanic Garden
signature.detail: A vast park overlooking the city and Swan River, with native botanic gardens and sweeping skyline views. It is free to enter and best explored in the cooler morning hours; it is a short walk or bus ride from the CBD.

signature.name: Swan River
signature.detail: The river that defines Perth, with foreshore paths, ferries and views back to the skyline. Take a ferry or riverside walk at sunset; the central jetties are easy to reach on foot from Elizabeth Quay.

signature.name: Swan Bell Tower
signature.detail: A distinctive tower on the waterfront housing historic bells, with an observation deck over the river and city. Check opening hours before you go and combine it with a stroll around Elizabeth Quay.

signature.name: AQWA (The Aquarium of Western Australia)
signature.detail: A large aquarium showcasing Western Australian marine life, including a walk-through tunnel. It is a good family stop north of the city; allow a couple of hours and check feeding times on arrival.

signature.name: Art Gallery of Western Australia
signature.detail: The state art gallery in the cultural centre, with Australian and Indigenous collections and free general entry. It is a cool indoor option on hot days; it sits near the CBD and is easy to reach by train or bus.

transport: Train/bus about $3-5 a ride; day passes available
